messages:
Alex (merchant): Hey team — seeing a spike of failed invoice charges this morning. Customer sees SCA challenge, gets redirected, then ends up back at checkout and we get a final decline. Example transaction: txn_8x7Yz. Gateway returns `card_authentication_required` then on retry `insufficient_funds`. Any ideas? @Maya

Maya (support): Thanks Alex — can you paste the webhook / gateway response you get? Are these all the same acquirer or multiple?

Alex (merchant): Most are on Acquirer A, a couple on Acquirer B. Repro steps I used: 1) Create invoice via API 2) Customer clicks pay 3) Redirect to 3DS provider 4) After challenge completes they return, UI shows "payment failed". Webhook payload (sanitized):

```
{"id":"pi_abc123","status":"requires_action","next_action":{"type":"redirect_to_url","url":"https://3ds.acquirer/req?session=xyz"},"last_gateway_response":{"code":"card_authentication_required"}}
```

After the redirect flow our server retries authorization and gateway logs show: `challenge_submitted -> challenge_success -> auth_attempt -> auth_declined: insufficient_funds` in a few traces, but in others we see `challenge_submitted -> challenge_timeout -> challenge_submitted -> auth_declined`.

Luis (payments-eng): Hmm. Two possibilities: 1) The browser completes challenge but the issuer isn't updating session state in time and our retry is getting an old state. 2) Acquirer has an automated retry policy that retries auth after a challenge and maps certain responses to `insufficient_funds`. Do you have a raw gateway trace (HTTP logs) with request/response IDs?

Alex (merchant): I attached the raw header lines below from one failed attempt:

```
POST /auth HTTP/1.1
Host: api.acquirer-a.com
X-Request-ID: rq_9f2
Body: {"three_ds_result":"y"}

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Gateway-Trace: gt_334
{"result":"challenge_passed","auth_status":"pending"}

-- 3s later retry --
POST /auth HTTP/1.1
X-Request-ID: rq_9f2-retry
Body: {"auth_attempt":true}
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
{"error_code":"insufficient_funds","decline_code":"insf_funds"}
```

Maya (support): Thanks, that helps. @Luis can you check whether our retry logic is firing too quickly (e.g., reauth before acquirer updates) or whether the gateway sends an asynchronous webhook later?

Luis (payments-eng): On it. My hunch: our client SDK auto-retries on network/timeout and sometimes triggers a second auth while the acquirer is still processing the 3DS completion. Two immediate mitigations: 1) add a short backoff after receiving `challenge_passed` before attempting auth (500-1500ms) 2) ensure we check for final webhook/websocket update from acquirer before reauth. Priya any infra suspects?

Priya (sre): Could be sticky session / proxy caching of POST responses on our merchant proxy causing the retry to re-send stale payloads. I'll grep the proxy logs for `rq_9f2` and check timebounds. Also check conn reuse and keepalive behavior between our proxy and acquirer.

payments-bot: alert created — support-1824009876 — severity: medium — tag: payments, acquirer-A

Maya (support): Alex — quick user-facing workaround: if you surface "Completing authentication — please do not refresh the page" and disable auto-retry on client side until we push a fix, you should see fewer conversions to `insufficient_funds`. Can you try that for a small %?

Alex (merchant): Yep will toggle the client flag for 10% of traffic and report back. Also asked a couple affected customers for screenshots.

Luis (payments-eng): I found a pattern in traces: our retry was occurring ~1.2s after `challenge_passed` in ~38% of failed traces. Gateway occasionally emits a delayed webhook ~700-1200ms after challenge. I'll open an ops ticket with Acquirer A with trace id gt_334 and request correlation notes. For code fix I'll throttle retries on `challenge_*` for 2s and mark as WIP.

Priya (sre): Proxy logs show a keepalive socket reused for rq_9f2 where response took 3200ms to finalize; that aligns with race. I'll add a short circuit to avoid cache-ing POSTs and ensure we don't prematurely respond to client with intermediate states.

Maya (support): Summary of action items: - Alex: enable client-side no-retry UI for 10% - Luis: throttle server-side reauth/backoff and escalate to acquirer (ticket created) - Priya: patch proxy cache behavior - Maya: monitor error rate and update affected customers

Luis (payments-eng): Ticket with Acquirer A created: ACQ-2026-881 (includes gt_334, rq_9f2). I also pushed a small server change to add a 2s backoff on `challenge_passed` and flag to skip auto-retry in SDK. Deploying to staging now.

Alex (merchant): Thx all — I'll monitor and report if the 10% sample improves.

Maya (support): Will follow up with a status note to customers. Marking this thread assigned to Luis for gateway escalation. :white_check_mark:
